articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Network Management System Based on Isolation Forest
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As an important part in network management system, rapid and accurate anomaly detection is one of the preconditions to guarantee the effective work of the network. In general, the network management system will monitor the data of multiple indicators, and the manifestations of network anomalies are complex in the data. Most existing anomaly detection approaches have encountered some trouble in network anomaly detection because of the periodicity of time series data or high time complexity and memory cost working on high-dimensional data. Aiming at the deficiency of present methods of network anomaly detection, we propose an adapted method based on iForest algorithm. We construct some feature extractors through statistical methods to highlight different abnormal behaviors in different indicator and then use the extracted feature data for the construction and prediction of iForest. Combining specific feature extractors, we can eliminate the effects of periodicity, or specify the detection of peaks or troughs to adapt to different indicators. By means of iForest algorithm which has linear time complexity and low memory requirement, our method makes a rapid detection with large dataset and works well in high dimensional network management data.

articleTitle: Electricity Power Load Forecast via Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper focuses on electricity load forecasting of large-scale electrical grid. The smart grid is developing rapidly in the half-decade; it becomes the new goal of electricity industrial construction. Stability, reliable, flexible and self-cure are the main electricity characters, and accuracy forecasting power load play an important role in this process of smart construction. In this paper, we take Estonia country power load as a case, convert the load data to supervised learning data, and then use long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent network do training model and forecasting. The experiment demonstrates the method is efficient, and compared with support vector regressive (SVR), LSTM could extract the feature of power load better accuracy and obtain the better performance of forecasting. The result can help national grid planning.

articleTitle: To Study and Analyse Human Behaviours on Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Recently, the scope of the digital world in increased in a way that a number of smart objects are connecting in a huge quantity. It is due to the exploitation of low-cost internet extensions, air-interface, and revolution in miniaturization. Hence, it results in decreasing the cost of a smart device. The growing gap between users and the Big Data analytics requires innovative tools that address the challenges faced by big data volume, variety, and velocity. Therefore, it becomes computationally inefficient to analyse such massive volume of data. Therefore, keeping in view the aforementioned needs, there is a requirement for a system that can efficiently analyse a stream of Big Data within their requirements. Hence, this paper presents a system architecture that integrates social network with the technical network. We derive a novel notion of 'Socio-Cyber Network', where a friendship is made based on the geo-location information of the user, where trust index is used based on graphs theory. To check the efficiency of the proposed algorithms exploited in the proposed system architecture, we have implemented our proposed system using Hadoop and MapReduce. Moreover, the system is evaluated in terms of efficiency by considering the system throughput and processing time.

Author Keywords: Big data, Socio-cyber network, Human behavior, Graphs, Friendship, Trust index

articleTitle: Adaptive Detection of Infrared Small Target Based on Target-Background Separation with Ratio Minimization of Singular Values
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Motivated by the infrared patch-image model, small target detection is transformed into an optimization problem of the low-rank and sparse matrix decomposition. Previous methods may have unstable performance when faced with extremely complex backgrounds with strong edges and dim targets. Thus, a new adaptive detection method for infrared small target using multi-scale fusion and parameter regulation is proposed, based on the non-negative target assumption and the ratio between partial and total sum of background singular values. The parameters for target-background separation are regulated adaptively using the image entropy and the standard deviation of image patches. A series of experiments shows that our proposed method has an excellent and stable performance in background clutter suppression, especially in extremely variant and complex backgrounds, and is more accurate with low false alarm rate compared with other baseline methods.

Author Keywords: adaptive target detection, infrared small dim target, sparse and low rank matrix decomposition, background suppression

articleTitle: Physical Fitness Clustering Analysis Based on Self-Organizing Feature Maps Network
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Clustering analysis based on self-organizing feature maps (SOM) network has been widely used in various areas of cluster analysis. In this paper, this network is applied to the clustering analysis of students' physical level. The software is used to study and train the designed self-organizing feature maps network. Correspondingly, Neural Network Model, and the physical measurement level of three levels of classification (The first level is good, the second level is qualified, the third level is unqualified), to achieve the level of physical cluster analysis. The results show that the self-organizing feature maps network can automatically classify the physical test scores unsupervised learning, and visually and clearly see the level classification of the physical test scores, analyze the main factors affecting physical fitness from the clustering analysis of physical test results.

articleTitle: The Virtual Museum Based on HoloLens and Vuforia
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the current development of VR, AR, and MR (3R) technologies, this article comprehensively considers the limitations of physical museums in digital applications and proposes a new generation of virtual museums that break the cognitive boundaries between 3R. The significance, innovation and technology of virtual museums based on HoloLens and Vuforia technology are discussed. The multiple dimensions are used to evaluate the application value and development direction of the virtual museum in the future.

articleTitle: Agricultural Product Quality Traceability System Based on the Hybrid Mode
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the demand of consumers for the quality and safety guarantee of agricultural products, a traceability system of agricultural products quality based on hybrid mode is designed and developed in this paper. The system connects the various links of crop planting, acquisition, processing, distribution and sales, and obtains the real-time information from crop seed cost to agricultural product sales. It can make farmland scientifically be managed according to the information of crop growth environment, improve the utilization rate of agricultural resources, and be beneficial to the sustainable development of agriculture. At the same time, the information of the processing, transportation, and sale of the crops from the seeding to the harvest to the agricultural products are recorded in real time in the database so that the consumers can understand the relevant information of the agricultural products in real time. If the unqualified agricultural products are checked out, the production of this kind of agricultural products can be controlled immediately from the source, and the circulation of unqualified agricultural products can be controlled more effectively. Therefore, the legitimate rights and interests of consumers can be effectively guaranteed.

articleTitle: A Dependent Variable Exclusively Coupled Chaotic System for a Pseudorandom Bit Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Coupling is a common approach for constructing new chaotic systems. In this paper, I present a novel way of coupling, which is utilized to construct a new chaotic system. Afterwards, a pseudorandom bit generator is proposed based on it. Next, I employ five statistic tests to evaluate the pseudo randomness of generated sequences. Linear complexity and cipher space are analyzed at last. All the results demonstrate that the proposed generator possesses excellent properties.

articleTitle: MSTI: A New Clustering Validity Index for Hierarchical Clustering
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The clustering validity index (CVI) is an important tool to measure the clustering effect and determine the optimal clustering number (K_opt). However, most of the existing CVIs cannot properly deal with some non-spherical distributions data sets and data sets with great differences in sample size and density among clusters. This paper proposes a revised hierarchical clustering algorithm based on the new clustering validity index (MSTI). Firstly, the new index uses spanning tree related knowledge to construct minimum spanning tree in inter clusters and maximum spanning tree in intra clusters. Then, the new MSTI is defined as the ratio of the cost of the minimum spanning tree among clusters to the cost of maximum spanning tree in each cluster. Under this circumstance, the K_opt is acquired when the above ratio reaches the biggest value. Finally, the new algorithm for optimizing and determining the K_opt is designed by leveraging the Average-Linkage hierarchical clustering algorithm and the new proposed MSTI. We compared the new algorithm integrated with MSTI with the traditional algorithms integrated with 4 commonly used CVIs by utilizing 3 simulated datasets and 3 UCI datasets. The experimental results have shown that the new proposed algorithm integrated with MSTI is effective and accurate in determining the K_opt and the optimal clustering partition for all the tested data sets.

Author Keywords: optimal clustering number, clustering validity index, hierarchical clustering, cost spanning tree

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Hotel Room Information Management System Based on Kendo UI Front-End Framework
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the rapid development of society today, along with the popularization of computer technology and the extensive application of the Internet, all walks of life are applying the computer management system to their own enterprises. As a member of the service industry, the hotel industry is also developing rapidly. In order to integrate the rapid development of computer network and hotel industry, to provide better service to consumers and to improve the management efficiency of hotels, hotel room information management systems have emerged. This article describes a management platform for hotel room's online booking and guest information using kendo UI front-end framework design. Using SSM (Spring, Spring MVC, MyBatis) framework to deal with background programs. The overall mission of system development is to ensure office staff can quickly and easily complete the hotel guest room management task, providing better and faster service for residents. The interface is simple and his operation is easy to maintain.

Author Keywords: Hotel room information management, kendo UI front-end framework, SSM technology

articleTitle: A Lane Detection Technique Based on Adaptive Threshold Segmentation of Lane Gradient Image
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of being difficult to adapt to the change of illumination conditions and the road shadow or other noises interference, an approach for real-time lane detection based on adaptive threshold segmentation of lane gradient image. Considering the feature that the lane line usually has a higher brightness than the surrounding road surface, that is, there is a larger grey value, we extract lane edge pixels by imitating Canny edge detection technique to extract edge pixels gradient and then segment it with a threshold obtained from OTSU algorithm. Finally, lane line detection and tracking is realized by Hough transform and Kalman filter. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed methods, and the detection results are consistent with the actual situation. The processing speed is about 16 fps, which basically meets the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Palmprint Verification System with Dual-Line-Single-Point Assistance on Android Mobile Devices
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Palmprint has several advantages in authentication on mobile devices; however, some serious challenges severely restrict the development of palmprint verification in mobile environments, such as various locations and gestures of hand, complex backgrounds, diverse illuminations, limited hardware resources. In order to overcome the aforementioned problems, we designed and implemented a novel palmprint verification system with an assistance technique, namely dual-line-single-point (DLSP), on Android mobile devices. The environment setup and variable configuration on Android operating system were carried out according to the demand analysis. In software subsystem, the main interface and image capture interface were designed to meet the system requirements. All kinds of classes and threads were programmed in Java language. Finally the software and hardware were jointly debugged. The sufficient test results confirm the effectiveness and practicability of the developed palmprint verification system.

articleTitle: Noncircular Signal DOA Estimation with Reduced Dimension MUSIC for Coprime Linear Array
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation method of noncircular signals by combining noncircular property and coprime linear array signal processing. This method can significantly extend the array aperture and increase its degree of freedom (DOF). For non-circular signals, it usually needs two-dimensional spectrum peak search, which needs amount of computation to get the estimates of incident angles and non-circular phases. To reduce the computational complexity, a reduced-dimension MUSIC method is used here for the DOA estimation of noncircular signals without estimate the non-circular phase. The angle estimation performance of the proposed method is much better than that of the conventional MUSIC method for uniform linear array (ULA) and coprime linear array (CLA). Furthermore, the proposed method works well without estimating the noncircular phases and a locally spectrum peak search is used to further decrease the computational complexity. Extensive simulations have been conducted and the results show that the proposed method can achieve accurate DOA estimation under different SNR conditions.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection for Sleep EEG Signal via Mahalanobis-Taguchi-Gram-Schmidt Method
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Considering the tedious steps, the poor accuracy and over-subjectivity of human sleep quality judgment artificially, this paper presents an automatic detection algorithm of sleep quality based on Mahalanobis-Taguchi system method. Based on the modeling and analysis of the human brain dual channel EEG signals, the normalized vector of each channel is obtained under different sleep stages. At the same time, the linear independent vector group is subjected to Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization, and the mean value of the signal-to-noise ratio of each sleep stage is calculated by using the Mahalanobis-Taguchi-Gram-Schmidt method. Through analyzing the waveform of the mean signal-to-noise ratio on different sleep stages, the normal and the abnormal sleep quality can be identifiedfinally. Experiments show that the algorithm can effectively detect normal and abnormal quality of sleep.

Author Keywords: Abnormal detection, Mahalanobis-Taguchi system, sleep stages, Signal to Noise ratio

articleTitle: Landmark Fitting for Sequential Faces Based on Active Shape Model and Tracking Correction
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, a method of landmark fitting for sequential faces is presented based on active shape model(ASM) and tracking correction. This method overcomes the loss of consecutive information between frames, and makes full use of the motion variation information of video sequences in time and space dimensions. Firstly, the optical flow values of several key points on the face are calculated by the large displacement optical flow model. Secondly, the positions of these points in the current frame are located to modify the global shape model of ASM and conduct the precise localization of landmarks in landmark searching. Finally, the rationality of landmark is suppressed to obtain the ultimate results. Our proposed method observably improves the accurate localization of ASM for deformed faces, and takes full advantage of the continuity among video sequences, so that it has significant effect on landmark fitting for sequential faces. Compared with ASM, extensive experiments show that our method performs outstandingly in terms of accuracy and robustness.

Author Keywords: active shape model, landmark fitting, large displacement optical flow model, global shape model

articleTitle: Accelerating EM Missing Data Filling Algorithm Based on the K-Means
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the whole process of data mining, the EM algorithm is widely applied to dealing with incomplete data for its numerical stability, simplicity of implementation, reliable global convergence. the main disadvantage of the EM is slow convergence speed, the algorithm is highly dependent on the initial value of the option, In this paper, the clustering results use K-means algorithm as the initial scope of EM algorithm, according to the different choice of different characteristics of mining purposes, then use incremental EM algorithm (IEM) step by step EM iterative refinement repeatedly, it obtains the optimal value of filling missing data quickly and efficiently. it is concluded that the optimal value of filling missing data experimental results show that the algorithm of this paper to speed up the convergence rate, strengthened the stability of clustering, data filling effect is remarkable.

articleTitle: Risk Identification and Simulation Based on the Bayesian Inference
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To reveal risk problems of youth innovation and entrepreneurship under the Internet crowdfunding, this paper proposed the youth innovation and entrepreneurship risk indicator system under Internet crowdfunding from several levels such as the Internet crowdfunding platform of entrepreneurial potential, and education. The risk identification method of case analysis was formed through combining the construction of index system with Bayesian inference, thus it can realize the identification of risks and conduction paths rapidly and dynamically, and provide optimization advice for the healthy development and efficient integration of the Internet crowdfunding and the innovation and entrepreneurship.

Author Keywords: internet crowdfunding, youth innovation and entrepreneurship, risk identification, bayesian inference, simulation

articleTitle: DOA Estimation of Nested Electromagnetic Vector Sensors Array via MUSIC Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose the idea of combining the nested array with the electromagnetic vector sensor to achieve the spatial spectrum estimation. The subspace algorithm of (Multiple signal classification) MUSIC algorithm is applied to the Direction of Arrival (DOA) estimation, and the spatial smoothing technique is utilized to the covariance matrix of virtual received signal here so that its rank can be restored. Compared with the uniform scalar sensor array, the proposed method has higher angle estimation performance and higher spatial Degree of Freedom (DOF). Through a nested array of only N physical sensors, O(6N2) DOFs is obtained. Otherwise, the angle estimation performance of a vector sensors array is better than the scalar sensors array.

articleTitle: Android Malware Detection Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Among various mobile terminals, Android system is widely favored by users because of its open platform, rich software content and services. At the same time, Android malware is also emerging for the purpose of obtaining improper profits, which brings serious security problems to the Android platform. Therefore, effective security mechanism needs to be proposed to detect malicious software. This paper is based on Android system and machine learning technology. It detects Android malware from two aspects of static analysis and dynamic analysis.

Author Keywords: Android malware, machine learning, static analysis, dynamic analysis

articleTitle: Anomaly Behavior Detection Based on Ensemble Decision Tree in Power Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper proposed a new scheme to overcome the non-technical loss in the line loss of the distribution network. Based on the raw data derived from the power system, the differences between normal users and frauds, especially on the power consumption, are explored firstly. Combining with Spark platform, an ensemble decision tree model is developed which can be applied on the distributed system for big data analysis and efficiently confirm suspected customers. Experimental results show that comparing with individual decision model, the proposed ensemble model has strong parallel computing ability is suitable for the analysis of massive data and valuable in practical applications.

articleTitle: Mixed Traffic Mode Based Travel Route Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Travel route recommendation is an important part of the field of intelligent transportation, which can provide the guidance of travel mode and travel route for travelers. However, the current travel route recommendation methods are single mode, which make the traveler choose only one kind of traffic mode when traveling. And because of the complexity of urban transport modes, such a single traffic plan recommendation often fails to meet the expected requirements. In order to solve the limitation of the single vehicle travel method, we propose a travel route recommendation method which includes three modes of transportation, including rental, subway, and walking. By constructing a travel route recommendation model in mixed traffic model, the problem of route recommendation is transformed into a shortest path problem in the travel route map, and we can get the travel route according to the shortest path. According to this route recommendation method, we have created an APP to recommend routes for travelers, and considering the traveler's requirements for travel time and travel expenses are various, we can recommend a most suitable route according to travelers' preference for time or cost.

articleTitle: Surgical Navigation System Based on the Visual Object Tracking Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel surgical navigation system based on visual tracking algorithm, where the 3D position of surgical instrument and patient will be determined from 3D visual sensor and displayed by computer graphic method. Different from traditional systems based on ultrasound and motion capture, our system used a Kernel-Reliability K-Means (KRKM) clustering algorithm as our targets tracking algorithm. By applying the KRKM tracker to the RGB image obtained from the Realsense camera, the system can locate the pixel coordinates of colour markers on the surgical instruments and those on the patients' body. According to these coordinates, our system can obtain their 3D coordinates from the depth images created from Realsense camera. Then, we proposed a stepwise coordinate fusing algorithm to convert the coordinates of camera, surgical instrument and patient into a new uniform one which is centered at patient body. It can simplify the calculation of all coordinates systems of our system. At last, according to the real-time tracking result of the surgical instruments in the real 3D space, a models by using openGL and openMesh library in virtual 3D space to display location and orientation information can be built. The experimental results show that surgical navigation system based on the visual object tracking algorithm can satisfy the requirements of accurate, stable and real-time for surgical instrument tracking and patient positioning.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Threshold of QR Code Recognition Based on Maximum Likelihood Criterion
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The recognition and user experience of mobile QR scanning is mainly determined by whether it can detect and read the two valued data of blocks' gray (or color) information quickly and accurately. In order to further improve the level of mobile phone reading QR code and user experience, based on maximum likelihood criterion, this paper gives an optimal threshold algorithm for fast and accurate reading of QR code encoding information. It can mainly use in QR code scavenging software or plug-in. Through mobile phone scanning QR code, get the black and white (or color) blocks' gray (or color) value of its recorded information; quickly calculate the best decision threshold. It effectively improves the QR code's recognition effect and user experience. The algorithm can effectively solve the literacy problem of the QR code scavenging under the influence of illumination and other adverse conditions.

articleTitle: A DOA Tracking Algorithm for Coprime Planar Array via PAST
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Compared to traditional planar arrays, coprime planar arrays have more precise direction finding precision and higher degrees of freedom. As there is little research on DOA tracking of arbitrary dynamic targets in coprime arrays, a DOA tracking algorithm based on Projection Approximation Subspace Tracking (PAST) for coprime planar array is proposed. It can achieve the real-time tracking of arbitrary dynamic target's two-dimensional arrival angle. The computational complexity of the proposed algorithm is much lower than conventional Esprit algorithm because it does not need to construct the autocorrelation matrix and perform eigenvalue decomposition, as well as the online tracking feature of the proposed algorithm ensures the real-time tracking performance. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the algorithm on DOA tracking and show that the proposed algorithm has better performance on DOA estimation than traditional uniform planar array.

articleTitle: An Infrared Small Target Fast Detection Algorithm in the Sky Based on Human Visual System
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor real-time performance of traditional algorithms and high false alarms when there are complicated cloud disturbances in the scene, this paper proposed an infrared small target fast detection algorithm in the sky based on the human visual system. At first, a local contrast measurement method with single scale was proposed to quickly calculate candidate targets. Then, the Laplace Gaussian scale space theory is introduced to calculate the multi-scale filter response of the candidate targets. According to the difference of the statistical characteristics of the response value, the real target is obtained through adaptive threshold segmentation. Experimental results show that the proposed method has a detection rate of up to 97%, and a false alarm rate of lower than 3%, and our method can calculate the target position within 5ms for a 256×200 image.

articleTitle: A Firefly-Cuckoo Search Algorithm for Optimizing the Beam Patterns of the Random Antenna Arrays
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, a firefly-cuckoo search algorithm (FCSA) is proposed to solve the beam pattern optimization problem of the random antenna arrays (RAA). FCSA introduces the Levy flight mechanism of the cuckoo search algorithm as the global search operator to improve the performance of the conventional firefly algorithm. Several simulations are conducted to evaluate the proposed approach and the results show that FCSA has better performance in terms of the accuracy and the convergence rate for reducing the maximum sidelobe level (SLL) of the RAA.

articleTitle: A Visible Light Indoor Positioning Algorithm Based on Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Errors are caused by wall reflection and noise in the visible light indoor positioning system. Some indoor positioning algorithms based on fingerprint are compared through simulation. An improved indoor positioning algorithm that combines K-Nearest Neighbor and Bayesian theory algorithm is proposed. Firstly, several grid points which are close to the receiver's position are selected by KNN algorithm, then the posterior probability is calculated by Bayesian algorithm. The point with the largest posterior probability is the estimated position. The improved algorithm simplifies the Bayesian algorithm and improves the positioning accuracy of KNN algorithm, with an average error of 0.27m.

articleTitle: A Study on the Security of Patch Management in a Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: As cloud computing techniques advance, Virtual Machines (VM) seems to be an appropriate solution than physical machine deployment. Having multiple instances of virtual machines cause more efficient use of computing resources to achieve the aim of energy consumption and cost effectiveness. In this thesis, Virtual Machine Image Catalogue (VMIC) is designed for helping users search and acquire expected virtual machine images promptly. Nevertheless, security of VMIC is also a crucial task to keep systems up-to-date and defends against security attacks. Pakiti is adopted to monitor patch status of physical and virtual machines, and schedules the warning information to remind security staffs to update the patches.

articleTitle: Research on Intrusion Resistance Measure Method of Space-Based Early Warning System Based on Network Connectivity Entropy
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the structural features of the space-based early-warning system and the introduction of the complex network theory, a complex network topology model is mapped to the space-based early-warning system, and then combined with the node comprehensive value measurement method and in-formation entropy theory; the network connectivity entropy is proposed to be invulnerable. Measure model. And use this measurement model to measure the value of some nodes in the space-based early warning system. Finally, the variable pa-rameters were set to simulate the grey attack experiment of the complex network of space-based early warning system and a comparative analysis was conducted.

articleTitle: A Diffserv Model for Video Stream
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Video plays an important role in security monitoring, intelligent traffic surveillance, streaming media and other fields. As the internet technology evolves, especially increasing of 4G network coverage further expands the scope of its application. As a kind of multimedia service with strong time correlation; video surveillance not only needs to occupy larger network bandwidth, but also requires very strict network transmission delay. This leads to many problems of video stream such as poor picture quality and long latency due to the network bandwidth and limited device processing capacity. To solve the problems above, a kind of quality of service model named Diffserv is proposed in this paper. It concludes pockets classification, traffic monitoring, congestion avoidance, network congestion management etc. Meanwhile the network test of video data stream is carried out and the test results are given.

Author Keywords: Quality of Service, differentiated service, diffserv

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving Algorithm Based on Flow Matrix Network
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the increasing scale of the Internet, the problem of network energy consumption is attracting more and more attention. At present, computer network is faced with problems such as high energy consumption, low efficiency and low link utilization. These problems have become a bottleneck restricting the further development of computer network. In this paper, an Internet routing energy saving algorithm based on flow matrix is proposed, which maximizes the utilization of network link and minimizes network energy consumption on the basis of ensuring network efficiency.

articleTitle: Joint Bayesian Face Recognition Based on Data Adaptive Enhancement and Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the face recognition, training data is sometimes limited, and even a single face photo per person, which causes the model less trained to recognize the multi-pose facial image with low recognition rate. In this paper, aiming at the face recognition using small sample training set, a joint Bayesian face recognition algorithm based on adaptive face data enhancement combined with global and local feature fusion is proposed. The face key points are detected and then expanded and rotated to extend the face data samples, and face model is established by combining the global and local features. The experiment result shows that the proposed algorithm makes the multi-gesture face recognition performance well.

articleTitle: The Independent Core Observer Model Computational Theory of Consciousness and the Mathematical Model for Subjective Experience
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper outlines the Independent Core Observer Model (ICOM) Theory of Consciousness defined as a computational model of consciousness that is objectively measurable and an abstraction produced by a mathematical model where the subjective experience of the system is only subjective from the point of view of the abstracted logical core or conscious part of the system where it is modelled in the core of the system objectively. Given the lack of agreed upon definitions around consciousness theory, this paper sets precise definitions designed to act as a foundation or baseline for additional theoretical and real-world research in ICOM based AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) systems that can have qualia measured objectively.

articleTitle: Point-of-Interest Recommendation Based on Spatial Clustering in LBSN
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In location-based social networks, many studies have been put into forward to improve point-of-interest (POI) recommendation, according to the users' historical check-ins and context aware information. But the spatial distribution feature of the users' check-in has not been well studied. We propose a POI recommendation algorithm based on spatial clustering, through studying whether the users' check-in behaviors have "active area" differences. Firstly, a spatial clustering algorithm is designed according to the administrative area information of the POI in the location-based social networks, which is combined with users' check-in distribution characteristics. Secondly, the users' ratings information is normalized. Finally, POI recommendation is obtained according to integration each user's check-in spatial clustering subset distribution and user's ratings to social relationships. The experimental results show that the significant improvement and the effectiveness of the method in the precision, recall rate and time performance.

Author Keywords: POI recommendation, active area, spatial clustering, users' ratings, social relationship

articleTitle: Exploration on the Cultivation of Innovative Talents in Higher Vocational Education
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the current information era of Internet +, aiming at the universality of education target, the purpose of training, the technicality of educational content, the diversity of educational methods and the directness of educational benefit, and according to the characteristics of Hanzhong Vocational and technical College, this paper puts forward "internet + education" = internet + training model of innovative talents in education industry. We have reformed and explored in some aspects such as: smart campus, education management public services, optimizing educational resources, education and teaching supervision, classroom teaching resources sharing and so on, and have achieved some results worthy of communication and promotion.

Author Keywords: Internet+, vocational, and, technical, education, resource, sharing, smart, campus, innovation, and, exploration

articleTitle: 3D Reconstruction of Fundus Vascular Structure Based on Binocular Stereovision
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to obtain accurate 3D information of the retinal vascular structure, this paper presents a method of 3D reconstruction of retinal vascular structure based on binocular stereovision. According to the structural characteristics of blood vessels in the fundus, the blood vessel is simplified into a skeleton of single-pixel width. The bifurcation points and the line segments between these points are extracted and described. The bifurcation points are firstly matched by epipolar geometry and then the line segments between two bifurcation points are used to match the pixel points on the line segments. Finally, the matched bifurcation points and line segments were reconstructed by the parameter matrix of the camera in order to improve the spatial information of the blood vessels in the fundus, and to completely depict the 3D structure of the vascular veins in the fundus. Through the demonstration and experiments, this method can realize 3D reconstruction of the retinal vascular structure and the real-time monitoring of retinal position and posture to be examined, which can be used to correct the B-scan images of the OCT and provide an accurate 3D image for ophthalmology.

articleTitle: Control Chart Recognition Method Based on Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Control chart is a useful method to identify process problems by detecting abnormal pattern, to keep process in control. Aiming at the problem that traditional abnormal patterns were fixed, and could not completely identify all process problems, a control chart recognition based on transfer learning was proposed. Firstly, six kinds of abnormal patterns were abstracted from the characteristics of abnormal processes. Apply Monte Carlo to create simulated data, and process data to reduce the effect of noise by standardizing and coding. Control chart images were used as target dataset instead of numerical data. According to the feature based transfer learning in the isomorphic space, apply VGG16 network model to extract feature to improve the generalization ability. Finally, the output of the feature extraction was the input of the classifier that has been well trained on the target dataset. Control chart recognition model was fine-tuned according to the recognition results during the process of training, to gain the optimal one. The experimental results show that compared with BP network model, the accuracy of control chart recognition network model based on transfer learning is more than 98% with the less sample data.

Author Keywords: control chart, Monte Carlo, VGG16, transfer-learning, fine-tune

articleTitle: Long-term Tracking Based on Kernelized Correlation Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of kernelized correlation filter tracking algorithm such as scale change, severe occlusion and tracking failure under similar target tracking, a long-term target tracking algorithm based on KCF is proposed. The algorithm introduces color information into the tracker, and the scale information makes the algorithm adapt to the more complex situation when tracking. It is worth noting that the trackers train two models, one to represent coordinates and the other to characterize confidence. In addition, training online support vector machine classifiers is also crucial. This article uses a multi-expert tracking strategy to enable longterm tracking to be re-detected in the event of a failed tracking condition. The validity of the proposed algorithm is verified by the OTB-2013 [1] evaluation sequence. Compared with several other classical algorithms, this algorithm has been significantly improved. In the target occurrence scale, occlusion, deformation and other interference cases with strong robustness.

articleTitle: The Influence on Medical Activities by Mobile Medical Application
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Various mobile medical APPs appear designed for mobile smart phones in China recent years, providing more approaches between patients and doctors. It offers more convenient and prompt medical information and service exchange. Though there still exist some unfavorable factors, mobile medical application improves patient medical experience, the relationship between doctors and patients, the doctor's self-price value and contain the huge commercial value. In the future, as the improvement of the laws and regulations, the increasing of the market competition and advancement of technology, it will change the medical pattern completely, especially for out-patients.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Allocation Strategy of Networked Control System under Denial-of-Service Attack
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, security of networked control system (NCS) under denial of service (DoS) attack is considered. Different from the existing literatures from the perspective of control systems, this paper considers a novel method of dynamic allocation of network bandwidth for NCS under DoS attack. Firstly, time-constrained DoS attack and its impact on the communication channel of NCS are introduced. Secondly, details for the proposed dynamic bandwidth allocation structure are presented along with an implementation, which is a bandwidth allocation strategy based on error between current state and equilibrium state and available bandwidth. Finally, a numerical example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed bandwidth allocation approach.

articleTitle: Indoor Positioning for Dementia in Smart Homes Based on Wearable Device
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to track the trajectory of the elderly with dementia in indoor environment, it is important to constantly to monitor the position of the elderly with dementia. Therefore, we proposed an indoor positioning method based on hand free device -smart bracelet. The challenge of the indoor positioning basing on smart bracelet is that the Bluetooth signal is not only subject to indoor environments, but also affected by the motion of hand. Indoor items, body shading and other factors will cause the signal diffraction, reflection or even loss. For this challenge, we use median filter to reprocess the original signal and integrated the RSSI features with the features of the wrist's gestures. After that we use random forest to establish the position model and adopt the finite state machine(FSM) to calibrate the result of the classify model. It's proved that the proposed system has good robustness and can accurately locate the elderly in the indoor environment.

articleTitle: Doppler Frequency Offset Estimation Algorithm for Terahertz Dynamic Imaging Signal
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Terahertz Imaging promotes microscopic dialysis and deep utilization of electromagnetic wave, and provides significant foundation for exploiting microscopic and high frequency object while challenges as channel interference and Doppler frequency Offset of dynamic signal are still urgent to be solved. Hence, this article comes up with Doppler frequency Offset estimation algorithm for Terahertz dynamic Imaging signal. This article starts from analysing signal model and channel influence of Terahertz Imaging, further proposing feature analyses for signal interference in imaging channel, and ends in implementing radio frequency and baseband of the receiver. A handling method is designed for Doppler frequency Offset of received dynamic signal and it can validly compensate Doppler frequency Offset of dynamic signal. The simulation proves that the algorithm in this article can improve estimation accuracy of Doppler frequency Offset in Terahertz Imaging.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of WeChat Mini Program Based on Secure QR Code
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The common QR Code application presents an explosive growth, but it is easily replicated. Therefore, there is a serious loophole in which it can be counterfeited and infringed. Aiming at this problem, this paper designs and develops a WeChat Mini Program on the basis of security QR Code research. Through this program, the scavenging access problem is solved, the use range of secure QR Code is expanded, and the user experience is optimized. In this paper, the relevant technical architecture of the WeChat Mini Program has been built to meet the needs of the application of "one object, one code" in the anti-counterfeit tracing. A secure QR Code WeChat Mini Program that has functions such as product inventory query, anti-counterfeiting verification and product information release is designed and implemented, which can be applied to commodity consumption, traceability, authenticity and other application scenarios.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Geological Environment Survey Big Data Platform for Danjiangkou Reservoir Water Source Area Based on WebGIS
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Danjiangkou reservoir water source area is the source of the water source area of south-to-north water diversion. In order to confirm the specific conditions of the local geological environment, geological environment surveys occupy a very important position. During the survey, a large amount of geological environment data was generated. These data are extremely scattered and cannot be used in a comprehensive manner. For more efficiently using the geological environment survey data and realizing the function of polyphyletic, heterogeneous data management and real-time dynamic update, the paper explained how to use the SQL Server database, rely on the MapGIS geographic information system platform, and carry out secondary development based on the double services of the MapGIS IGServer, and establish a Geological Environment Survey Big Data Integration System based on WebGIS. The polyphyletic, heterogeneous spatial data and attribute data are uniformly processed, stored, searched, managed and analyzed. Data support will be provided for in-depth geological research, analysis and land planning for the Danjiangkou Reservoir water source area on this system platform.

articleTitle: A Research on Valuation System for Storage Optimized Surveillance Video
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: It is difficult to effectively manage storage of surveillance video, owing to the large volume of data, low value density and limited storage time. This research analyses the concept named as magnitude of value of surveillance video, as well as introduces a valuation system that quantifies the value of surveillance video, providing theoretical foundation for dynamic storage management towards data distribution and optimisation based on magnitude of value. According to the result of experiment, this valuation system has satisfactory performance in differentiating surveillance videos with different value.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Engine Fault Detection Method Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: To diagnose the engine fault quickly and effectively, we purposed a method to engine diagnosis, based on Twin Support Vector Machine. This method utilized five exhaust gas parameter values of HC, CO, CO2, O2, NOX and normalized them. Then it took these data as feature vector for test and train in Twin Support Vector Machine classifier, so as to achieve the purpose of identifying fault categories. The experimental results shows that twin support vector machine have better effect than Neural Network or Support Vector Machine, and the training speed is faster. In the case of small sample data, the accuracy rate of fault diagnose can reach 97.6%, which can effectively describe the complex relationship between the changes of vehicle exhaust components and engine default.

articleTitle: An AHP-Based Evaluation Information System for Integrated Portals
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet technology, integrated portals become one of the most important ways for users to obtain information from Internet. However, the qualities of various integrated portals are not similar. Therefore, it is very important to develop evaluation systems for evaluating integrated portal websites. This paper applies analytic hierarchy process (AHP) to develop an evaluation information system for evaluating integrated portal websites. The developed system is a web-based network information system. C# information system development language and SQL Server database management system are applied to the implementation of the system.

articleTitle: Survey of Kernel Extreme Learning Machine Kernel Function Based on the Perspective of Kernel Parameter Optimization Time
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM) is more and more widely used in various fields, and the factor that determines the performance of KELM is the selected kernel function. The kernel functions are divided into two common types in this paper: the kernel inner product functions and kernel functions based on orthogonal polynomials that only require values in natural numbers. From the perspective of kernel parameter optimization time, the current research status and development of the above kernel functions are systematically summarized, which provided relevant researchers with the development history and latest results of the research direction.

articleTitle: DOP: A Data Opening Framework and Application
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Data opening has been the trend in the era of big data, confronting with problems of general engineering implementation of data opening. The data-open-pool (i.e., DOP) framework and the "Catalog-Dataset-Distribution" (i.e., CDD) data description model are proposed in this article based on metadata management and big data storage. It realizes business logics of data involving in data collection, distribution and opening. In addition, it discusses on description and management of data resources on the three layers. Finally, it illustrates examples of convenient implementation of data opening with hierarchical description models of DOP and CDD, and discusses on several problems about the framework.

articleTitle: Research on Image Restoration Algorithm for Blind Deconvolution
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze the effect of point spread function on image restoration. This paper first analyzes the causes of image blur, second describes the basic model of image blur, and analysis several classical image restoration algorithms. It is found that the larger and smaller point extension functions make the result of image restoration worse. The conclusion is that the setting of the point spread function is very important in the classical image filtering method.

articleTitle: Distortion Correction of Building-Fisheye-Images
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The fisheye image is the image taken with a fisheye camera, in which the object suffer from distortion. The street view building images are always taken by fisheye cameras due to the boarder view of the very cameras. So, the distortion of the images must be corrected before further applications. This paper compared three state of the art's distortion correction algorithms, including algorithm based on Polynomial Model, algorithm based on Division Model, and algorithm in [1]. The comparison results on both synthetic and real data show that algorithm in [1] performs the best.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Sparse Channel Estimation Based on Support Agnostic Bayesian Orthogonal Matching Pursuit
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: According to sparse channel estimation and Bayesian theory, Support Agnostic Bayesian Matching Pursuit (SABMP) is characteristic of inferior convergence. To improve the convergence rate of SABMP effectively, a new method named sparse channel estimation based on Support Agnostic Bayesian Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (SABOMP) is proposed in this paper. In this new method, the orthogonal-method is introduced to increase convergence speed, which makes residual and the column vectors corresponding to the selected model to be orthogonal in each residual update. The simulation results show that the proposed method has high estimation precision, especially under low signal to noise ratio (SNR). Furthermore, compared with the original method, the convergence speed of this method is faster, and the efficiency of sparse channel estimation is higher.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mutual Coupling in Cross Quasi-Orthogonal Antenna
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The mutual coupling effect will have some influences on the electrical performance parameters of the antennas. In order to evaluate mutual coupling, the special simulation software and huge calculation are usually needed. As a result, coupling effect mitigation methods are hard to be testified because of the complicate model. In the view of those problems mentioned above, a simple mathematical model for mutual coupling is proposed in this paper. MATLAB and FEKO are used to cross-validate the relevant models. Theory analysis and simulations are presented to prove that when a cross antenna is working on one antenna and another antenna does not work, the magnitude of mutual coupling is 10-5. The induced voltage is small, which will hardly affect the transmitting signal of the working antenna. At the same time, the proposed method can effectively solve the problem of mutual coupling analysis of cross quasi-orthogonal antennas with high accuracy and small amount of calculation. It provides a good estimation scheme for antenna measurement and design.

articleTitle: Chromatic Aberration Analysis and Correction of Fore-Optics of a Light Field Imaging Spectrometer
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Light field imaging spectrometer is a snapshot spectrometer which can capture spatial and spectral information of objects in one snapshot. Chromatic aberration of the fore-optics will cause deviation of the imaging position of the filter-array. The effect of the chromatic aberration of the fore-optics of a light field imaging spectrometer is analyzed and a correction method is presented.

Author Keywords: Light Field Imaging Spectrometer, System Optimization, Chromatic Aberration, Imaging Simulation

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Mass Incidents Based on System Dynamics and Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Nowadays the mass incidents have become one of the factors that affect the stability of society. The research on their evolutionary process is of great significance to find out the new theories and methods of public safety. Based on the methods of system dynamics and multi-agent, we establishes a model that apply to the evolutionary mechanism of mass events and puts forward four related subjects that influence mass incidents. The subjects are public, government, media and community. The model can reflect the evolutionary mechanism of mass incidents and provide the theoretical support for emergency management of government.

articleTitle: Regulation Characteristics of Chinese Medicine on Inflammatory Corpuscles
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Inflammatory bodies play an important role in the innate immune response of human body. Different inflammatory bodies play different roles in human body and are related to different diseases. Chinese medicine has the advantages of safety and little toxicity to the liver and kidney. The study of traditional Chinese medicine provides a new and important way to find a safe and effective drug preparation for the prevention and treatment of inflammatory body related diseases. In this paper, the classification and generalization of inflammatory bodies and the influence of traditional Chinese medicine on inflammatory corpuscles are reviewed, which provides reference for related research.

articleTitle: A Current-to-Voltage Conversion Device Using a NdFeB Magnet, Permalloy, and Shear-Mode Piezoelectric Material
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents a current-to-voltage conversion device, which is constructed from a magnet, a coil, and two shear-mode piezoelectric plates assembled between retaining plates and a permalloy plate. When energized, the coil generates alternating magnetic filed interacting with the magnet. The current-to-voltage conversion effect essentially results from the force interaction between the magnet and the permalloy plate. The shear stress is then transmitted to the piezoelectric plates which produce voltage output, and the conversion is completed. The average conversion factor reaches 0.39V/A at 1kHz when the current varies from 18mA to 200mA. The results illustrate the potential of the proposed device as magnetic field energy harvester for wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: User Space or Kernel Space: Performance Evaluation of QAT Accelerator
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of big data and cloud computing, an increasing amount of data is encrypted before it is sent across the network or stored on disk to provide confidentiality. OpenSSL is the most widely used encryption tool to protect the data security over network. However, encryption is a compute-intensive workload. To improve the performance of OpenSSL encryption, many cryptographic hardware modules are designed to accelerate encryption. The hardware accelerators work by offloading the computing from CPU. In this work, we first analyze the hardware encryption models with OpenSSL and Intel® QuickAssist Technology (QAT) accelerators implemented in user space and kernel space. Then, we conduct various experiments to evaluate the performance of encryption using different approaches. Based on the experimental results, we demonstrate the effectiveness of QAT and give the sensible suggestions to choose the suitable mode for the specific application.

Author Keywords: QAT, Synchronous mode, Asynchronous mode, User space, Kernel space, OpenSSL

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Finding the Semantic Relationship of Datasets
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to programmatically discover semantic associations between datasets, promote open sharing of linked data. In this paper, a description model of relational datasets is designed, and a datasets association detection method based on semantic similarity is proposed based on the characteristics of datasets. The experiment shows that this study can not only realize the correlation of the basic description level of the datasets, but also find the semantic association between the entities in the datasets. This method can realize the semantic interconnection across datasets, to improve the relevance of data and information.

articleTitle: The Implementation and Application of Interactive Meteorological Service Based on APP
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Depending on the development of Internet of Things (IOT) and smart phone technology, mobile APPs are becoming increasingly prevailing in the general public, thus, weather service APPs have become one kind of most popular APPs among varied types of mobile APPs. Therefore, an attempt of implementation of new conceptual weather service mobile APP based on SOA framework with fine-gridding data through intellectual and interactive approach has been discussed in this study.

articleTitle: Study on MOOC Flip Classroom
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The application of MOOC is developing rapidly. More and more schools are introducing MOOC into the classroom. MOOC flipping classrooms has become an important way of application. There are also many teachers who have achieved good results in MOOC flipping classes. This article describes the flow of MOOC flipping classes and analyzes the benefits it brings to classroom teaching. At the same time, it also objectively pointed out the problems in the MOOC flipping classroom. Although there are still many problems in the MOOC flipping class, we should not give up trying and exploring it. In the end, the article put forward four suggestions to face it correctly. Only by constantly reforming education can we adapt to the development of society.

articleTitle: Study on Productivity of Chinese High-Tech Industry: An Empirical Analysis Based on Provincial Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper uses the stochastic frontier model (SFA) to measure the change of total factor productivity (referred to as TFP) of high-tech industry of China's different regions, based on panel data of China's high-tech industry from 2000 to 2014. The study shows that during the sample period the TFP growth rates of high-tech industry of China on the whole and the eastern, central and western regions of China first increased, then declined and stayed relatively stable in recent years. The TFP growth rates of the eastern, central and western regions differ from each other. Technical progress and scale efficiency growth are the drivers of the growth of TFP of China's high-tech industry, but technical efficiency plays a negative role. Further results show that industrial clustering, export trade and human capital have positive effects on the TFP of high-tech industry, R&D investment and the introduction of technology have also positive effects but not significant.

Author Keywords: high tech industry, total factor productivity, measure

articleTitle: Experimental Research on Applying Imagery Training Method in Teenager Table Tennis Training Classes
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, the experimental research was done to 30 teenager table tennis players at Haidian District Amateur Sports School by the method of imagery training. The training effects of the imagery training method and the traditional training method were compared. The experimental results show that the athletes who adopt the imagery training method have significantly higher standard performance results and technical evaluation results than those who use the routine training methods. The results of SPSS 22.0 test show that they reach the significant level and can effectively improve the athletes' technical level and training effect.

articleTitle: Research on Requirements Analysis Method of Space Information Support Equipment System for Anti-missile Combat
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In order to solve the task -capacity demand index mapping problem of the aerospace information support equipment system effectively, proposing a demand mapping method (GQFD) based on the combination of quality function deployment and gray correlation method and giving the implementation process of the method. The grey relational matrix replaces the relation matrix in the original HOQ, which avoids the subjectivity caused by the relationship matrix directly from the expert experience, and improves the accuracy of the application results of the QFD method. Take the aerospace information support anti-missile operation as an example; we have obtained the capability demand indicators and the importance of the space information support equipment system, which provides a theoretical guidance for the construction of the space information support equipment system.

articleTitle: Voice Conversion Based on Unified Dictionary with Clustered Features between Non-parallel Corpus
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) has been widely applied to exemplar-based voice conversion(VC) recently. It differs noise robustness and naturalness of the converted voice, compared with conventional statistical Gaussian mixture model-based VC. However, parallel training data from source and target speakers are required so it can not realize the arbitrary speakers' voice conversion, especially when the corpus of target speakers is inadequate. In this paper, we present a novel algorithm by clustering the spectral features in high dimensions to construct the unified dictionary and introduce a mapping matrix between source and target sparse coefficients. Experimental results demonstrate that the value of average cepstral distortion is 0.833 which is about 4.3% lower than the performance of conventional NMF based method. Subjective evaluations such as ABX and MOS are also discussed. It indicates that the speech quality in our study is quite better than conventional NMF. The target speaker's spectra are even unnecessary to be included in the training set.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Forecasting in Grid-Connected Wind Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Proportion of grid-connected renewable energy power generation in the micro-grid system keeps increasing year by year, however, renewable energy power generation has a strong intermittency and volatility, which may bring some adverse effects on the power grid and affect the power quality to a certain extent. Meanwhile, it will also reduce the reliability of system scheduling operation, increase the operating cost of the system. Improving the power forecasting and load forecasting ability of renewable energy power generation, solving a reasonable power system scheduling optimization model of grid-connected renewable energy power generation can improve the utilization of renewable energy, reduce the effect of micro-grid system on the grid. Firstly analyze different power generation forecasting methods of green renewable energy, secondly compare different load forecasting methods. Then present situation of subject related application technology at home and aboard are introduced in details, finally summarize the research status of micro-grid system, discuss the existing issue of current research, and look forward to the future of research direction.

articleTitle: A Design Scheme of Multispectral Criminal Detector
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: A new design scheme of multispectral criminal detector is proposed to overcome the problem that the existing hyperspectral criminal detection instrument possess tedious extraction of physical evidence information, the expensive equipment and so on. First, CIS(Contact Image Sensor) is selected to emit five sources of red, green, blue, infrared and ultraviolet, and so the image information produced by light source is obtained. Then, the high precision image information and high-speed data transmission are acquired by FPGA. Finally, the Gabor filter algorithm is used to extract feature information and support vector machine training for realizing the extraction of fully automated material evidence. Experimental results show that the output resolution of the proposed design scheme is as high as 1200x2400DPI, and material evidence extracting takes 12.5 seconds, furthermore, the accuracy rate of automatic material evidence recognition is as high as 92%. The proposed design scheme can quickly and accurately realize the fingerprint, alter or cover the handwriting automatically.

articleTitle: Recommend Device Defect Research Based on Optimized Edit Distance Algorithm and Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper proposes a defect recommendation method based on an optimized edit distance algorithm and entropy weight method. The connection between the production management system (PMS) and the operation management system (OMS) need they choose defects personally, which results in staff workload increased significantly and data interact unreasonably. Firstly, the optimized edit distance algorithm is being used for classifying defects identification, and then use entropy weight method to evaluate the type, in order to achieve the intelligent recommendation to relevant personnel. The experimental results show that the implementation of the proposed method greatly reduces the workload of the relevant personnel, and improves the accuracy of the defect information recommendation.

articleTitle: Two-Dimensional DOA Estimation with Partial Damaged Sensors in Rectangular Array Based on Tensor Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In the field of direction of arrival (DOA) estimation, there exists no problem of angle merging and it has low sidelobe characteristics with the uniform rectangular array. But when sensors in the uniform rectangular array are partially damaged, the two-dimensional DOA estimation performance of the original algorithms will seriously decline, and even have a performance failure in some cases. To solve the problem, we study the inexact augmented Lagrange multiplier method (IALM). Through utilizing features of low-rank matrix, obtained by the tensor unfolding in different modes, in the tensor model of the received signal, we propose the IALM-ESPRIT algorithm. Compared with the direct ESPRIT algorithm, the performance of two-dimensional DOA estimation is significantly improved when partial sensors damaged.

articleTitle: Back Propagation Neural Network Based Data Adaptive Storage Method for Heterogeneous Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Heterogeneous storage devices are commonly used in nowadays storage systems. In this paper, we propose a new Back Propagation neural network based Data adaptively storing Method (BPDM), in order to adapt the heterogeneous devices by storing the frequently accessed data in immediate future in fast devices as much as possible. The experiment results show that BPDM performs well on heterogeneous devices based storage systems. In statistic, BPDM gains up to 33.2% and 49.8% less average responding time and average serving time compared to other existing methods.

articleTitle: Research on Innovation Application of Community O2O Based on Consumer Demand Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This article embarks from the community O2O enhance residents' quality of life, by applying the method of questionnaire, survey residents foreign selling order, logistics services, and information security requirements, combined with the questionnaire data analysis of the problems existing in the community and questionnaire data, put forward "the consumer acceptance of community O2O with consumers' gender and their social role on" hypothesis, according to the test results, put forward building community O2O platform construction protection programs, community O2O better meet residents living requirements, improve the quality of life.

articleTitle: Digital Metering Based on Multi-unit Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Regarding the problem that the digital substation meter may receive two or even three combined unit data packages at the same time, this paper designs a digital smart grid metering system based on multiple merging units. The system adopts the idea of layered design to realize the stable receiving of data packages, fast frame resolution, data arrangement and frame loss compensation. Finally, the high precision measurement value of electrical parameters is obtained by zero-crossing lookup algorithm. Experiments show that the system has the advantages of high precision, strong compatibility, good stability and low cost.

articleTitle: Research of Human-Machine Interaction System for a Humanoid Robot Based on Network Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The operator directly controls the humanoid robot which is in another space by human's behavior after receiving the scene information of the robot. This control method is more consistent with the practice of the operator, and it makes human's behavior extended in another space. However, it also puts forward higher requirements for the human-machine interaction and the telepresence of the robot system. This paper presents an architecture of human-machine interaction system based on distributed structure. And the delay problem of the network is analyzed under this architecture. In order to conduct human-machine interaction experiment in the laboratory, we designed a set of test methods based on the time-delay simulation principle. The experiment demonstrates that the system has abilities between telepresence and human-machine interaction.

articleTitle: A Corpus-Based Study on the Collocation between Degree Adverbs and ABB-Type Descriptive Adjectives
