publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: The collocation between degree adverbs and descriptive adjective is, syntactically, restricted in Chinese. However, since the beginning of the new century, more and more linguistic evidences have shown that quite a number of descriptive adjectives can be modified by degree adverbs. Based on large Chinese corpus, this paper will research the collocation between degree adverbs and ABB-type adjectives. Evidence from corpus and statistics show that all kinds of degree adverbs can match ABB-type descriptive adjectives, which are gradually acquiring certain characteristics of attributive adjectives.

Author Keywords: Degree Adverbs, ABB-type Descriptive Adjectives, Collocation, Corpus

articleTitle: Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Based on Stacked Denoising Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a typical chronic neurodegenerative disease. Mild cognitive impairment (MCI) is a transitional stage between health and AD. Early diagnosis and early treatment can significantly prolong the survival of patients with Alzheimer's disease. By mining gene expression data and extracting the expression pattern of AD/MCI related genes, it is of great significance for early detection of AD. Here we applied a three-layer stacked denoising autoencoder (SDAE), which is a promising approach extract useful features, to the gene expression data of AD patients in the database of Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI). By optimizing numbers of hidden layer nodes and corruption levels, we constructed a model with low loss. Using the features generated from SDAE, an SVM classifier was constructed to classify health status and AD/MCI samples. Results showed that the characteristics of SDAE were significantly better for the classification of AD than the raw gene expression data. Different hidden layer of SDAE was able to extract different dimensional features. Integrating all the three-layer features, the classification accuracy of 744 samples in the ADNI dataset reached 100% in 10-fold cross validation.

articleTitle: Defect Detection of the Irregular Turbine Blades Based on Edge Pixel Direction Information
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a new method for detecting the defect parts of irregular turbine blades in real-time based on edge pixel direction information. Firstly we detect and track the turbine target with the background subtraction algorithm. And extract possible defective blades in fixed positions of the turbine. Then we split the whole system into two parts: 1) detecting the defect on the left/right terminal of turbine blade, where the well-known statistical HOG feature descriptor is applied to the extracted image corner. The defect blade could be found if its HOG feature is significantly different from that of a normal one; 2) detecting the defect in the middle blade with a new method where the shape changing of the blade edges caused by defect will be determined by applying the least-square method to fit the direction vectors within an adaptive detection window. The experimental results show the effectiveness of the proposed methods. The processing speed is about 11 fps, which basically meets the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: An Efficient Algorithm for Multiple Next-Hops Computation in Link-State Routing Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: A distributed algorithm has been proposed in the paper. The algorithm only needs to be constructing a shortest path tree, and loop-freeness of the induced forwarding path is guaranteed by the underlying partial order of the nodes. The time complexity of the algorithm is nearly the same as that of building a shortest path tree. We evaluate the algorithm in a wide space of relevant topologies, both real and synthetic, and the results show that it can achieve good reliability and fast recovery.

articleTitle: Research on Modeling of User Learning Interest Based on Evolutionary Computation
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Evolutionary computation is a computing discipline that mimics biological evolution and genetic laws. In order to realize the modeling of the user's interest in learning, an Evolutionary Computation Based Modeling (ECBM) method is proposed. The method uses a genetic algorithm to model the user's interest in learning and automatically evolves the model parameters. User interest modeling is the foundation and core of personalized learning.

articleTitle: Abundances Correction in Hyperspectral Data Unmixing to Handle Spectral Variablity
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Spectral variability is one of the main causes of reducing hyperspectral unmixing accuracy. Atmospheric condition variability and illumination intensity variability are two main reasons for spectral variability of hyperspectral data. A novel hyperspectral unmixing method based on endmember bundles under sparse regression based unmixing frame is proposed in this paper to handle it. Firstly, the hyperspectral data is corrected to reduce the spectral inconsistency between endmembers from library and imagery caused by varied atmospheric condition. Secondly, the hyperspectral data is unmixed under the sparse regression unmixing frame. Then representation model of spectral variability due to varied illumination intensity is established. Endmember bundles are also established according to this model. Finally, the unmixed fractional abundances are corrected by the endmember bundles. The method in this paper effectively reduces the influences of spectral variability caused by varied atmospheric condition and illumination intensity and promotes unmixing accuracy of hyperspectral data.

articleTitle: Compatibility Design of Tactical Communication Based on OFDM and SC-FDE
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Based on the application requirements of tactical communications, this paper proposes a compatible design of OFDM and SC-FDE to the communication system, and demonstrates and simulates the key technologies of synchronization, code length and equalization that need to be solved in compatible multi-carrier design. In addition, a breakthrough in key technologies has been achieved in the OFDM and SC-FDE compatible design of communication systems.

Author Keywords: OFDM, SC-FDE, Park synchronization, multipath, transformation, interpolation

articleTitle: A Transformation Method of Ontology Model to Network Topology Model
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: For the modeling of command information system network using direct mapping method, there is a problem that the modeling is not unified and standard. Based on the standardized ontology model of the command information system, a method of transforming the ontology model to the network topology model is proposed. Through the parsing of the standardization of the ontology model to obtain the required 3 elements to establish the network model, a network topology model is constructed, and the regional joint air defense command information system is transformed from the ontology model to the network model. The results show that the method can achieve the transformation from the command information system ontology model to the network topology model based on the parsed data, which can provide reference for on-demand parsing of other ontology models.

articleTitle: Effective Reversible Information Hiding Based on Block Priority of JPEG Images
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Due to the redundancy information of the JPEG image is less than the uncompressed ones, it is difficult to obtain high embedding capacity for hiding the secret information into JPEG images. Meanwhile, after embedding the secret information, the size of the JPEG image is significantly increased, which leads to the problems that the secret information is easily perceived and the image storage space is significantly increased. Aiming at the above problems, this paper proposes a reversible information algorithm based on the block priority of JPEG images. In the algorithm, the AC coefficients are firstly divided into three classes based on analyzing the visual characteristics, coding styles and DCT coefficient distribution of the JPEG images. Then, according to the distribution of three kinds of AC coefficients in the 8×8 sub-blocks, the priorities of blocks used to embed the secret information are decided. Lastly, the selected blocks are sequentially embedded with secret information according to their priorities. The experimental results have shown that, compared with the existing reversible algorithms, the proposed algorithm can effectively increase the embedded information capacity and restrain the size of the image after embedding secret information in the premise of guaranteeing the visual quality of the image.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Communication Module in Intelligent Temperature Transmitter Based on Freemodbus
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Freemodbus is an open source free Modbus protocol stack written by Austrians, and is widely used in embedded system field to realize the Modbus protocol. This article takes MSP430F149 MCU(Microcontroller Unit) as the control center. The MCU collects the raw sensor signals and converts it to digital temperature signals. Freemodbus works on the MCU, and communicates with a Modbus master station via RS485 to achieve the goal of intelligent temperature transmitter communication module. The test result shows that the communication module operates steadily, communicates reliably, and this project has certain practicability and popularization value.

articleTitle: Structured Sparsity Characteristics in Hyperspectral Unmixing
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Mixed pixels of hyperspectral image own very high sparsity if they are linearly represented by endmembers of aprior spectral library. Hence the sparse regression framework has been introduced to solve the linear spectral unmixing problem and produced sparse fractional abundances. But because of the high coherence of spectral library and noise disturbance, the solution could not be as sparse as real. Structure sparsity is introduced to the sparse regression based unmixing method to mitigate the disturbances and make the solution sparser and more accurate. This paper gives an overview of the structure feature of hyperspectral image such as spatial smoothness, collaborative sparsity and group structure of spectral library as well as corresponding structure sparsity based hyperspectral unmixing methods. Furthermore some ideas of future work on structure sparsity in the unmixing of hyperspectral image are proposed at last.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Detection Technique for XSS Vulnerabilities
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper studies the principle of vulnerability generation and mechanism of cross-site scripting attack, designs a dynamic cross-site scripting vulnerabilities detection technique based on existing theories of black box vulnerabilities detection. The dynamic detection process contains five steps: crawler, feature construct, attacks simulation, results detection and report generation. Crawling strategy in crawler module and constructing algorithm in feature construct module are key points of this detection process. Finally, according to the detection technique proposed in this paper, a detection tool is accomplished in Linux using python language to detect web applications. Experiments were launched to verify the results and compare with the test results of other existing tools, analyze the usability, advantages and disadvantages of the detection method above, confirm the feasibility of applying dynamic detection technique to cross-site scripting vulnerabilities detection.

Author Keywords: cross-site scripting(XSS), dynamic detection, simulated attack, black-box testing

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection in Traffic Scene through Cascade AdaBoost Classifier and Target Tracking
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Pedestrian detection is an important component in an intelligent traffic monitoring system. In this paper, a real-time two-layer pedestrian classification method is presented. In the approach, firstly, several simplified geometric features are used to train the first layer pedestrian detector based on cascade AdaBoost, especially the 3D height geometric feature. Then, an improved multiple feature matching models is adopted for the tracking process and the actual motion trajectories in a 3D space are built. After that, the motion trajectories are dealt with using the linear fitting method based on subsection process to form the final subsection trajectories. Finally, the second layer pedestrian detector is applied on the subsection trajectories for the further pedestrian detection. Experimental results show that the improved method in this paper has a high correct detection rate, as well as a fast detection speed.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Visible Optical Communication Technology in Surveying
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: In this paper, the visible light communication technology at home and abroad to start the status quo, described the core technology of visible light communication. According to the different definition of visible light communication, the definition of visible light using the scope of analysis. The application prospect of visible light communication technology in the new generation of measurement is analyzed, and the application scope, application characteristic and technology advantage of the visible light communication technology in the new generation measurement are expounded. By comparing and analyzing the Zigbee protocol and Jennet-IP protocol, it is proposed that Jennet-IP can be the preferred choice of the underlying network transmission operation protocol of visible light communication.

articleTitle: Using Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm to View Selection Problem Subject to Dual Constraints
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: This paper presents a shuffled frog leaping algorithm (SFLA) based solution to solve the View Selection Problem (VSP) subject to dual constraints, which is often used to accelerate data warehouse queries. Since VSP is both discrete and constrained, a greedy-repaired strategy under dual constraints is proposed to handle unfeasible solutions. This proposed solution also profits from a mutation strategy in order to improve the quality of solutions, particularly to avoid being trapped in local optima. Experimental results show that under different constraints combinations, SFLA is able to find a near-optimal feasible solution, with maximum error less than 1%. Comparisons with GA and PSO show that SFLA has better solution quality and faster convergence rate, and also scales with the problem size.

Author Keywords: materialized view, view selection, shuffled frog leaping, evolutionary algorithm

articleTitle: An Actuated Signal Coordination Control Algorithm Based on Data Fusion for Urban Arterials
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: A short-term level actuated signal coordination control algorithm based on data fusion for urban arterials is established to perform arterial coordination signal control. The architecture of the system enables quick optimization of short-term level at the frequency of 10 seconds. The short-term level control has two main modules. The first module is intended to estimate and predict arrival pattern of vehicles at intersections for different circles by fusing data output from several sub-modules in which loop detector data, probe vehicle data and historical data are processed. The arrival pattern is important to predict vehicle delay which is a critical function in the second module. The second module optimizes arterial signal plans by building an optimization model to minimize total arterial delay. Microscopic simulation using VISSIM shows that the short-term level control algorithm does well in making decisions to decrease average vehicle delay and stops compared with traditional algorithm MULTI-BAND. The algorithm is allowed to achieve good improvement on oversaturated traffic conditions.

Author Keywords: green wave, arrival pattern, vehicle delay, data fusion, simulation

articleTitle: Application of Test Case Selection and Fault Analysis Based on Orthogonal Experiment in Mobile Device Context-Aware Application Testing
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile devices and the advent and application of various sensors, a large number of context-aware applications have emerged. As more and more contextual information is available for these applications, the functions implemented are becoming more complex. Due to the variety of contextual information, the design of test cases requires very complicated combination of conditions, which greatly increases the difficulty of software testing. This paper proposes a test case selection method based on orthogonal experiment design, which greatly reduces the number of test cases under the premise of ensuring effective coverage, and at the same time, the method also has the ability of error location. The experimental results show that the test cases designed by this method are evenly distributed and show good comprehensiveness. By separating the influence of each independent factor, it is helpful to find out the influencing factors of fault detection rate and thus locate the fault.

Author Keywords: Software testing, Context-aware application, Test case selection, Orthogonal experiment design

articleTitle: Review on Intelligent Internal Attacks Detection in VANET
publicationTitle: 2018 4th Annual International Conference on Network and Information Systems for Computers (ICNISC)
abstract: Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks [VANETs] aim to increase Value added services to vehicular networks by ensuring traffic safety and efficiency, warning and informing the driver about road events and hazards. With the recent advances in technology and development of smart cities information security is crucial because of the nature of information shared across these networks. The main challenge facing VANET is information security. Nodes can be attacked from inside the network or outside. Insider attacks are attacks from authentic members of the network while outsider attacks are those from non-authentic members. This is even made more difficult considering the VANET characteristics like high mobility nodes, limitation to road network, dynamic network topology and the large scale of the network. To deal with these attackers methods such as Cryptography and trust are used. Trust establishment in VANET helps deal with insider attacks, although most of the existing solutions assume the attacker will always show a stable dishonest behavior over time, which is not the case with intelligent insider attackers, they exhibit intelligent behaviors to avoid detection. In this Paper we review existing solutions used in misbehavior detection with primary concern on intelligent attacks like the adaptive detection threshold, evaluation of trust among vehicles for independent time periods and draw conclusions, as well as give suggestions on future research to mitigate intelligent attacks.
